body: “※7⛬, push harder, hold on! Just five more laps and you can rest!”
In a small courtyard not far from the outskirts of ※1⛬, ※10⛬ was shouting, cheering on the ※7⛬ training in the yard.
At this moment, ※7⛬ was drenched in sweat, large beads of sweat dripping down its fur, its chest heaving violently, panting heavily.
Yet, its four limbs still moved powerfully, each step stomping heavily on the ground, kicking up a circle of dust, its eyes showing a stubbornness, with no intention of backing down.
※10⛬ stood by, his eyes fixed on ※7⛬, watching it train so hard, his heart filled with satisfaction, a smile unconsciously curving his lips.
But as he watched, his gaze gradually became somewhat distant, his thoughts like a kite with a broken string, drifting back to the past.
※10⛬ didn't know how it happened, but he somehow, inexplicably, was reborn into the ※2⛬ world.
Just like in those novels, he followed the law of transmigration across worlds, his background quite tragic; his parents passed away when he was young, leaving him an orphan.
When he was six, he was taken in by an orphanage in ※5⛬.
This ※5⛬ was no ordinary place; it was the main base of ※4⛬' boss, ※12⛬.

Logically, this place should have been very dangerous, but at that time, ※12⛬ hadn't revealed his identity yet and secretly put a lot of effort into maintaining ※5⛬'s public order, managing the city very stably.
Those low-level ※4⛬ members were clueless, completely unaware that their boss was right there.
The higher-ups knew, so ※5⛬, as ※0⛬, surprisingly didn't suffer much harm.
Because of this, the orphanage where ※10⛬ resided had an unusually good treatment.
Boss ※12⛬ didn't care about the small amount of money saved by cutting orphanage funds, so much so that benefits not enjoyed by orphanages in some legitimate League cities were all available here.
This also made ※10⛬ realize that the League side was somewhat corrupt, and he secretly clicked his tongue in amazement.
※10⛬, having a protagonist template, naturally also had a cheat.
When he first discovered he had come to the ※2⛬ world, he was so excited he jumped three feet high.
He thought to himself, 'Now I can personally raise a group of majestic and adorable ※2⛬, how exciting!'
But after staying in the orphanage for a long time, he realized that becoming a proper ※2⛬ ※8⛬ was too difficult.
If one only wanted to raise a Grass-type ※2⛬ as a companion, that would be simple; Grass-types eat little and are easy to raise, keeping a few for fun is very easy.
But if one truly wanted to make a name for themselves on the ※8⛬ path, first and foremost, they needed money; without money, it was simply impossible to move forward.
※10⛬, an orphan, relied entirely on the orphanage for support, so where would he get the money?
Just as he was worrying about this, the system popped out with a “whoosh.”
※10⛬'s hands trembled with excitement at the time, thinking, 'I'm saved now, will I be able to become a ※8⛬ smoothly?'
But when he carefully studied the system's introduction, a basin of cold water splashed over him, chilling him to the bone, and all his expectations instantly vanished.
It turned out to be an AI system.
To say it was useless, it had some use; to say it was useful, it wasn't as divine as ※10⛬ had imagined.

He used to read novels where protagonists got a sign-in system, and wow, legendary ※2⛬ and ※9⛬s were at their fingertips, the newbie gift packages were so rich they could blind you, and in the blink of an eye, they became ※3⛬ powerhouses,
dominating the world, tearing ※16⛬ apart, kicking ※13⛬, with ※14⛬ on his left arm and Cynthia on his right, infinitely glorious.
※10⛬ stared longingly at his system, feeling incredibly depressed.
This AI system lost a lot of data when it traveled through time and space, and now it was like a blank slate, lacking everything.
However, the system also had a few impressive functions.

One was the knowledge recording function: as long as ※10⛬ read a book or material, the system could immediately record it, like a super brain, available for him to retrieve at any time, giving him the ability to never forget anything he read.
The second was the information organization and analysis function: no matter how messy the data, the system could sort it out neatly and provide ※10⛬ with the desired results.

The third was the scanning function: how powerful this function was depended on the knowledge reserves collected beforehand; the richer the database, the more accurate and detailed the scanning results would be.
But this made ※10⛬ difficult again; as a child from an orphanage, where would he get so much knowledge for the system to collect?
He was filled with regret, thinking, 'If only I had been reborn in ※6⛬, where Professor ※15⛬ is; getting close to the Professor would allow me to obtain a large amount of research data,'
'my system would surely grow by leaps and bounds, and by then, wouldn't I soar to the sky?'
Unfortunately, there's no ※11⛬ for regret in this world.
※10⛬ weighed his options and felt that he was too young; without the orphanage's protection, venturing out would be like a lamb entering a tiger's den, with more bad than good outcomes.
This ※2⛬ world was not as beautiful as depicted in the anime; humans and ※2⛬ often fought to the death,
and every year, many people were attacked by wild ※2⛬, with a considerable number losing their lives.
※10⛬'s little joy, with a “poof,” extinguished by more than half.

However, he quickly cheered up, thinking that having a system was better than not having one; he was already so miserable, not having a system would be truly over, and a glimmer of hope was better than despair.
Thus, ※10⛬ lived a peaceful life in the orphanage.
In a blink of an eye, he was eight years old, and the orphanage arranged for age-appropriate children to go to school.

The school system here was three years of primary school, three years of middle school, and three years of university. The orphanage only covered the tuition fees for primary and middle school; university education had to be self-funded.
※10⛬ later learned about this and realized that he owed Boss ※12⛬ a considerable favor.
Without those six years of study, the system would not have been able to collect so much ※2⛬ data and knowledge.
Although most of the knowledge in the school library and database was basic content suitable for elementary and middle school students, quite common, thankfully, the school allowed free reading.
This greatly helped ※10⛬; the knowledge within was vast, and if he had to read it all himself, it would take him ten years.
Fortunately, the AI system came into play at this time. For books, ※10⛬ would flip through them once, and the system would collect the knowledge, then analyze and organize it;
as for knowledge on computers, it was strange, as long as there was no firewall blocking it, the system could directly scan and acquire it.
With the help of the system, from elementary school to middle school, ※10⛬ spent most of his time either working odd jobs to earn money or diligently studying in the school library.
By the time he graduated from middle school at fourteen, the AI system had already collected a large amount of data and had some practical utility.
Relying on the system, ※10⛬ also became a junior Breeder and a junior ※11⛬ maker; if not for resource limitations, his level might have been even higher.
However, ※10⛬ didn't want to be too conspicuous and didn't go for these two certificates.
An orphan, with such abilities at a young age, could easily attract trouble and be targeted by ill-intentioned people, which would be dangerous. So he preferred to be poorer than to be coveted.
Although he had no certificates, his abilities were real; working as an assistant in breeding centers and ※11⛬ shops, he earned more than other employees.
This became his confidence to leave the orphanage; otherwise, without any skills, he would starve on the streets.
